name: Eye Break
author: Shilai Li
description: A minimal, native eye-break reminder. 20-20-20, keyboard-driven.

barWidget.description: Countdown to your next eye break

schema.label: Interval
schema.description: Minutes of screen time between breaks. The 20-20-20 rule says 20.

schema.label: Break length
schema.description: Seconds to look at something 20 feet away.

schema.label: Show countdown
schema.description: Show the time remaining next to the bar glyph. Off leaves just the glyph.

schema.label: Pause when idle
schema.description: Stop the clock when you step away. An absence longer than one break counts as a break taken.

schema.label: Idle after
schema.description: Seconds without input before you count as away. Below a few minutes this catches reading, not stepping out.

schema.label: Pause in fullscreen
schema.description: Do not interrupt a fullscreen window. The break is retried a minute later.

schema.label: Strict mode
schema.description: Remove the skip key from the break screen. The break runs its full length.

schema.label: Heads-up
schema.description: Seconds of warning before a break, as a desktop notification. 0 turns it off.
